THE PORTRAIT EDIT
ISSUE 02 / THE PROMPT ISSUE
PORTRAITS & LIGHT
024
STUDY 035
Clean Nordic Tee & Blue Eyes
Rights check
Source: 24534.jpg
IMAGE PROMPT
An original young woman with long, straight blonde hair
swept to one side looks over her shoulder with striking
blue eyes and soft rosy lips. She wears a white
short-sleeve V-neck tee. Her expression is calm and
focused against a pale blue-gray seamless backdrop.
Soft, even studio light with minimal shadow. Palette of
pale blue, ivory, and soft rose. Clean and understated,
in the style of a Nordic minimalist catalog.
Clean, understated, airy
WORKING NOTES
- The pale palette and simple tee keep the focus on the
eyes.
- Add 'natural skin texture' to avoid a plastic look.
